title: Terminal sessions
description: A terminal session opens a shell inside a running service’s container. Opening and closing sessions is audited. What people type and see is not recorded.

setting.title: Access in this environment
setting.loadFailed: The terminal session setting could not be loaded.
setting.unavailable: This installation has not enabled terminal sessions, so nobody can open one yet. Its administrator needs to enable them. You can still choose this environment’s setting.
setting.enabled: Allow terminal sessions in this environment
setting.ownersOnlyHelp: A shell exposes the service’s environment and volumes, and can change what runs without a reviewed source change. Operators can open sessions unless you restrict them.
setting.narrowingHelp: Turning sessions off or restricting them to owners ends the open sessions the new setting no longer allows.
setting.widenHelp: You’ll be asked to confirm your identity when you allow sessions or let operators open them.
setting.conflict: Someone else changed this setting. Your choices are kept here, but they have not been saved. Load the current setting and review it before saving again.

open.title: Open sessions
open.loadFailed: Open sessions could not be loaded.
open.refreshFailed: Open sessions could not be refreshed, so this list may be out of date. Trying again automatically.
open.empty: No sessions are open in this environment.
open.endDescription: This closes the shell on {{target}}. Anything still running in that shell stops, and anything not saved in it is lost.
open.endAll: End all sessions in this workspace
open.endAllTitle: End all terminal sessions in this workspace?
open.endAllDescription: This closes every open shell in every environment of this workspace, not only this one. Anything not saved in those shells is lost.
open.allEnded: All sessions in this workspace ended.

history.title: Terminal session history
history.description: The 100 most recent sessions in this workspace.
history.loadFailed: Session history could not be loaded.
history.empty: No terminal sessions have been opened in this workspace.
history.caption: Recent terminal sessions

closeReason.closed: Closed by the person who opened it

refusal.installation: This installation has not enabled terminal sessions.
refusal.environment: An owner has not allowed terminal sessions in this environment.
refusal.notDeployed: This service is not deployed, so there is no container to open a session in.
refusal.agentUpdate: This server’s agent needs updating before it can open terminal sessions.
refusal.runtime: This server’s container runtime needs updating before it can open terminal sessions.
refusal.hostNotReady: This server is not ready for deployments. Check its preflight report.
refusal.hostOptIn: This server’s owner has not enabled terminal sessions on the host.
refusal.limit: Too many terminal sessions are open. Close one and try again.
refusal.ineligible: This container is not eligible for terminal sessions.
refusal.noShell: This container has no shell to open.
refusal.ticket: The ticket was wrong, expired, already used or presented by someone else.
refusal.forbidden: This person is not allowed to open terminal sessions here.
refusal.invalidInput: The request named a service or instance that could not be found.
refusal.mfaRequired: This person needs two-factor authentication to open terminal sessions.
refusal.emailVerificationRequired: This person needs a verified email address to open terminal sessions.
refusal.subscriptionRequired: This workspace needs an active subscription to open terminal sessions.
